description: Claim an item so other sessions and machines see it is being worked on: an issue with kind "implementation" while a fix is built in the background (needs worktree or runId; refused past maxConcurrentImplementations or when another implementation uses the same worktree on this machine), or a PR with kind "pr" while this session does Tier 2 work on it. Re-claiming renews this session's claim; a claim another session holds is refused unless takeover is true. synced: false means the claim exists on this machine only.

runId.description: Remote worker run id when the implementation runs off-machine

session.description: Name of the session taking the claim, e.g. air/20261102T120733-3f9a

takeover.description: Replace a live claim another session holds on this item; without it such a claim is refused

ttlHours.description: Claim lifetime in hours (default 24 for implementation, 12 for pr)

url.description: Issue URL for an implementation claim, PR URL for a pr claim

worktree.description: Absolute path of the checkout the implementation runs in; one running implementation per checkout

name: work-claim
